nature: RECORD-INTEGRITY CORRECTION ONLY. No verdict, gate, threshold, number or piece of evidence moves. Raised by an independent Luna critic through cx.

correction_1_governing_criteria_was_inac.what_it_said: evidence-freeze.json v1 through evidence-freeze-v5.json, each with its own receipt
correction_1_governing_criteria_was_inac.why_wrong: two errors. It stopped at v5 when v6 exists, and 'each with its own receipt' is false for v1 — v1 carries no paired receipt file; its assertion is embedded inside the criteria document itself.
correction_1_governing_criteria_was_inac.corrected_statement: v1 carries an EMBEDDED receipt inside its own document. v2 through v7 each carry a PAIRED receipt file named <criteria>-receipt.json.
correction_1_governing_criteria_was_inac.verified: evidence-freeze-receipt.json does not exist on disk, confirming the embedded form for v1

correction_2_prefix_hashes_in_immutable_.finding: evidence-freeze-v5.json and evidence-freeze-v6.json each store a 24-character PREFIX in supersedes.sha256, not a full SHA-256
correction_2_prefix_hashes_in_immutable_.v5_stores: 154b8d7fdc3bb6c806c885ab (24 chars) — a prefix of the v4 hash
correction_2_prefix_hashes_in_immutable_.v6_stores: 4fab9343436aca59315f551b (24 chars) — a prefix of the v5 hash
correction_2_prefix_hashes_in_immutable_.why_not_fixed_in_place: v5 and v6 are immutable and receipted. Editing them to lengthen a field would break the very discipline the receipts exist to enforce, and the receipts' own hashes would no longer match. The defect is recorded here instead.
correction_2_prefix_hashes_in_immutable_.rule_going_forward: every hash recorded anywhere in this namespace is a full 64-character SHA-256. The correction chain in equation-identification.json is the authoritative index and the focused test refuses anything shorter.

the current-value check is no longer five literal price strings; it walks every JSON recursively and rejects any key naming a current, fair, target or base value for SPX, NDX or QQQ, and any numeric leaf in the index-level range under such a key
